rules.rule: Get formContext from executionContext.getFormContext(). Attributes hold data (getValue, setValue, getText); controls hold UI (setVisible, setDisabled, notifications); one attribute can have several controls. Xrm.Utility.getGlobalContext for user and org.
rules.trap: Xrm.Page; DOM access; attribute and control methods swapped

rules.rule: Designer when makers must see or switch handlers off (Enabled, pass execution context). Code (addOnChange, addPreSearch, addOnSave, addOnPostSave) for PreSearch and conditional handlers; guard against double registration; setValue doesn’t fire OnChange.
rules.trap: Arrow functions that drop the context; registering in both places

rules.rule: Xrm.WebApi with logical names; read lookups as _name_value, set them with NavProperty@odata.bind and the entity set; $select; follow nextLink; execute for custom APIs (operationType 0 action, 1 function). Runs as the user.
rules.trap: Entity set name in Xrm.WebApi; secrets in web resources

rules.topic: Commands with Power Fx and JavaScript
rules.rule: Modern commands live in one app. Power Fx actions and Visible formulas (Self.Selected.Item for one row, AllItems for several). JavaScript action: one library and function, parameters such as PrimaryControl and SelectedControlSelectedItemIds. Classic commands can’t be edited in the designer.
rules.trap: Hiding a button as security; Item for multi-select

rules.rule: navigateTo (target 2 = dialog, position 2 = side) returns savedEntityReference; openConfirmDialog resolves { confirmed }. Form notification informs; control notification blocks save; global notification survives navigation and can have an action.
rules.trap: openForm losing unsaved work; window.alert or window.open

rules.rule: init once (elements, listeners, callback); updateView on every change (render from context, honour isControlDisabled); getOutputs returns bound values after notifyOutputChanged; destroy removes listeners and timers.
rules.trap: notifyOutputChanged in updateView (render loop)

rules.rule: property (of-type, usage bound/input/output), type-group for several types, data-set and property-set for views, resources (code, css, resx, platform-library), feature-usage for WebAPI, Utility and Device, external-service-usage for domains (premium in canvas).
rules.trap: Renaming or retyping a property already on forms

rules.rule: StandardControl<IInputs, IOutputs> or ReactControl; types generated from the manifest; IOutputs only for bound and output properties; datasets: sortedRecordIds, paging, setSelectedRecordIds, openDatasetItem.
rules.trap: webAPI update of the record the form shows; editing generated types

rules.rule: Solution project (pac solution init, add-reference), production build, a higher version for every change, forms and views shipped with the component; pac pcf push only in a dev environment; canvas makers accept updates; new versions can’t add required or remove properties.
rules.trap: Publish all; pac pcf push to Test

rules.rule: Declare features in feature-usage (Device.* with required="false" when optional); getEntityMetadata before hasEntityPrivilege; webAPI runs as the user; formatting and navigation need no declaration.
signals: fails to load in the browser
rules.trap: Typings mistaken for runtime availability; isControlDisabled as a privilege check

rules.rule: Add connector data sources with --connection-ref and --solution-id, never a personal --connection-id for shared use; each environment maps the reference; service principal connections for service-level access.
rules.trap: Sharing a personal connection; secrets in the app

rules.rule: pa app add data-source --connector dataverse --table <name>: no connection id, runs as the signed-in user. Not yet supported: polymorphic lookups, table-definition CRUD, FetchXML, alternate keys.
rules.trap: Service accounts; FetchXML

rules.rule: Generated services for create, get, getAll, update, delete; update only changed columns; lookups with @odata.bind; getMetadata for localized display names (options aren’t returned); cache metadata.
rules.trap: Sending every column; metadata per row

rules.rule: pa app find-dataverse-api, then add dataverse-api --api-name; bound operations take the row id first; WhoAmI returns the systemuser id; runs as the user.
rules.trap: Entra object id used as systemuser id

rules.rule: Only solution-aware instant flows with the Power Apps trigger (pa app list-flows, add flow); regenerate after changing inputs; the flow runs with its connection references’ identities.
rules.trap: Scheduled or automated flows; stale generated signature

rules.rule: Microsoft Copilot Studio connector, ExecuteCopilotAsyncV2 (Execute Agent and wait) with message and agent name; render the answer as text; agent name per environment from settings.
rules.trap: Older operations; rendering the reply as HTML

rules.rule: @envvar:<schema name> for data-source arguments (dataset, table) in power.config.json; other runtime settings read from Dataverse environment variable tables; secrets stay in Key Vault behind flows or connectors.
rules.trap: Secrets in the app; Learn pages disagree (re-check)

rules.rule: Environment-wide, per directive. Custom values are appended to defaults, except where the default is 'none' (connect-src), which they replace. frame-ancestors controls embedding. Reports are sent regardless of enforcement. Setting directives replaces the whole collection.
rules.trap: Turning enforcement off; wildcards; the wrong directive

rules.rule: npm SDK served from 'self'; setConfig({ logger: { logMetric } }) once; forward sessionLoadSummary and networkRequest; connection string from Dataverse settings (or getContext with constants); no personal data; ingestion origin in connect-src.
rules.trap: CDN snippet; @envvar for the connection string

rules.rule: pa app push (with --solution-id) to Dev; service principal publishing needs a one-time edit share; Test and Prod through the managed solution, pipeline and settings file; Premium-type licence; canvas sharing limits; no Power Platform Git integration.
rules.trap: pa app push to Prod; Git integration; group sharing against policy

rules.rule: Monitor for app opens and error codes; DevTools Console for CSP, Network for request hosts (apihub.net connectors, dynamics.com Dataverse), Performance for rendering. Application Insights only sees loaded apps.
rules.trap: Querying Application Insights for launch failures

rules.rule: Measure first (TTI, request count); remove N+1 with batched filters and a session cache; run independent loads in parallel; $select only needed columns; keep the bundle small.
rules.trap: Bigger page size; FetchXML; persistent browser storage of customer data
